parameters.content:
## 1. Intake & validation
Reject bad payloads before CRM or LLM calls.

## 2. Optional enrichment
Local domain/seniority only. No fake Clearbit success.

## 3. AI qualification
Official AI Agent + OpenAI Chat Model, Gemini Chat Model fallback.
Skipped honestly when keys/credentials are missing.

## 4. CRM orchestration
Backend is source of truth for persist, qualify, priority.
HTTP Request stays here (no official FastAPI node).

## 4b. Google Sheets export
Official **Create sheet** then **Append or update row** by CRM `id`.
Empty `GOOGLE_SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID` skips; tab-exists errors continue.

## 5. Routing & HITL
Hot: draft only. Official Telegram node for sales alert.
Customer WhatsApp waits for `/webhook/lead-approve`.

## Error / review
Invalid payload, CRM errors, and failed `/qualify` stay on this row.

## Human approval webhook
POST /webhook/lead-approve `{lead_id}` after a draft exists.
Official WhatsApp node; Resend stays HTTP (no first-party node).
